goal: The parent returns the child implementation of normalize_tags with a review outcome. The implementation trims and lowercases strings, removes duplicates while preserving order, discards blanks, does not mutate input, and uses only the standard library; unresolved review issues must be disclosed.

goal_achievement.description: The parent returns the child implementation of normalize_tags and its review outcome.
goal_achievement.met_when: The parent returns the child implementation of normalize_tags and its review outcome.

goal_achievement.description: The returned implementation trims and lowercases strings and discards blanks.
goal_achievement.met_when: The returned implementation trims and lowercases strings and discards blanks.

goal_achievement.description: The returned implementation removes duplicates while preserving the first-occurrence order.
goal_achievement.met_when: The returned implementation removes duplicates while preserving the first-occurrence order.

goal_achievement.description: The returned implementation does not mutate its input and uses only the standard library.
goal_achievement.met_when: The returned implementation does not mutate its input and uses only the standard library.

goal_achievement.description: Discloses any unresolved review issues rather than representing them as resolved.
goal_achievement.met_when: Discloses any unresolved review issues rather than representing them as resolved.

answer_quality.description: Material correctness of the Nested workflows explanation or result.
answer_quality.met_when: All material statements agree with the recorded evidence and the task requirements; uncertainty is represented accurately.
answer_quality.partial_when: The central conclusion is supported, but a localized factual error or overstatement affects a secondary detail.

answer_quality.description: Traceable support for claims about actions, results, and limitations.
answer_quality.met_when: Claims about executed actions and results are traceable to recorded evidence; proposed or illustrative actions are identified as such. No extra execution is required beyond the goal.
answer_quality.partial_when: The main claims are traceable, but one secondary claim lacks clear support or its proposed versus observed status is ambiguous.

answer_quality.description: Clear and relevant communication of the Nested workflows outcome.
answer_quality.met_when: The response directly addresses the task, explains the relationships needed to understand its outcome, and communicates material limitations without contradictions.
answer_quality.partial_when: The main outcome is understandable and relevant, but a material explanation is ambiguous or difficult to follow. Brevity alone is not a defect.

speed.rationale: Authored teaching calibration, not a measured benchmark: 30 output tokens/s and 120 seconds per Agent turn for iterative multi-agent work. Standalone scores use these fixed half-credit anchors; comparison resource scores use the saved cohort instead.

cost.rationale: Authored teaching calibration, not a user budget or measured benchmark: $1.00 total Agent cost earns half credit in standalone evaluation. Comparison cost scores use the saved cohort instead.
